Nadia, Gideon called both lanes working as of **11:07 AM on 3 Aug**. He posted it in the channel at 11:08 AM.

The first check-in once kiosk 1 came back was **trailer 8836**. Mateo reported it at 11:03 AM: "Kiosk 1 is back. Guard checked in trailer 8836; dispatch sees it."

Both times come from this channel's history. The guard was also logging trailers on a clipboard during the outage, and I can't see that, so it's worth checking if you need the very first arrival.
